title: Kong reports 72% year-over-year EMEA customer growth
summary: This is the strongest new commercial signal in the review window. Rapid regional customer growth and named enterprise and AI-native wins improve confidence in demand, although the regional figure cannot be treated as company-wide ARR growth.
confirmed: Kong reported a 72% year-over-year increase in EMEA customers and 71% headcount growth in the region over two years.
Kong named ING Bank, First Abu Dhabi Bank, Mistral, and PolyAI as notable new customers and opened offices in Paris and Milan.
uncertain: Kong did not disclose the starting customer count, regional revenue, company-wide growth, ARR, churn, retention, or sales efficiency.
The 71% headcount expansion may support growth but also increases operating expense.
